novoe.color_swatch_text: The hint to keep drawing in this colour now shows a small square of that colour on its button, so you see at once which colour you will draw with.
novoe.ocr_install_text: No text recognition? The text window has an Install recognition button, and at the bottom you see which language and engine were used.
novoe.otlozhit_text: The new version window has a Postpone button: choose a better time for the update.
novoe.oznakomlenie_text: The Tour of features item in the tray icon menu: all features of the program, new ones on top. A practice image, a live demo and a check that you got it.
novoe.phone_target_text: When a photo arrives from the phone you can choose: Into this image or As a separate image.
novoe.phone_target_title: A phone photo: where to put it
novoe.qr_big_text: The code in the From the phone window is larger, and Enlarge opens it full screen: easier to aim the camera.
novoe.settings_apply_text: In the settings the Apply button saves your changes without closing the window.
ozn.arrows_hint: Pick the arrow (key A) and drag from start to end. Shift: exactly horizontal, vertical or 45°.
ozn.blur_hint: Select what must be hidden: a password, a name, a number. On the finished image it cannot be read.
ozn.color_swatch_text: A colour square on the button
ozn.copy_hint: Ctrl+C copies the image and the window stays. Copy and close (Ctrl+Enter) copies and closes. Nothing is copied here.
ozn.crop_hint: Select the area to keep, adjust the frame and press Crop or Enter. Esc: cancel, Ctrl+Z: undo.
ozn.eraser_hint: Whole: a touched mark is removed entirely. Partial: erases pieces. The screenshot under the marks is never touched.
ozn.full_hint: The panel button captures the whole screen. With several monitors pick one or all at once.
ozn.full_text: The whole monitor in one click
ozn.help_hint: The question mark button: intro to the program, update check, rating, About, news in Telegram.
ozn.idle_hint: Stuck? Press Show me and I will do it once more.
ozn.info_note: This feature cannot be shown on the practice image: it lives in the program itself.
ozn.marker_hint: The marker (M) underlines and highlights, the pencil (P) draws as is. Shift: straight line.
ozn.move_hint: Click a mark: move it or change it by its handles. Delete: remove. Ctrl and drag: copy.
ozn.no_clip: Practice image: nothing is copied to the clipboard.
ozn.no_save: This is a practice image: nothing was saved or copied.
ozn.numbers_text: Each colour counts on its own
ozn.ocr_hint: The program recognises words on the image. Sweep over the ones you need: the text goes to the clipboard and into a window where you can edit it.
ozn.ocr_text: Take the text from a picture
ozn.other_area_text: Select another part of the screen
ozn.oznakomlenie_text: All features on a practice image
ozn.panel_caption: The panel appears under the selected area.
ozn.panel_note: This is the panel after Alt+W. The place to look at is circled.
ozn.phone_editor_text: A phone photo straight into the image
ozn.phone_tile_text: Shoot with the camera or send a picture
ozn.phone_tray_hint: The phone item in the tray menu opens a window with a QR code: point the phone camera at it, take or send a picture, and it opens in the editor.
ozn.phone_tray_text: An item in the tray icon menu
ozn.phone_tray_title: Photo or screenshot from the phone
ozn.played: Done. To restore the image press Start over.
ozn.record_hint: The button starts the system's own screen recorder. ClipSD only opens it.
ozn.region_hint: Press Alt+W: the screen freezes. Outline the area with the mouse and a panel with buttons appears under the frame.
ozn.region_text: Alt+W: outline the place you need
ozn.save_hint: Ctrl+S asks where to save. Nothing is saved on the practice image: the button only says that it is one.
ozn.save_text: The image to a PNG or JPEG file
ozn.settings_hint: The gear opens settings: hotkey, screenshot folder, language, look, translation, updates.
ozn.shapes_hint: Pick the rectangle (R) or ellipse (E) and outline what you need. Shift: square or circle, Ctrl: filled.
ozn.show_hint: Press Show and the example draws itself. Or try it yourself.
ozn.text_hint: Click the image and type. Ctrl+Enter or a click aside finishes, Esc cancels. A callout (K) points at a spot.
ozn.translate_head_text: Translation and language in one row
ozn.try_hint: Try it yourself on the image on the right.
ozn.try_now: Your turn: do it on the image.
ozn.undo_hint: Ctrl+Z undoes the last action, Ctrl+Y brings it back. While the window is open, everything can be undone.
ozn.welcome_text: A practice image will appear here. Click and try: nothing is saved.
ozn.welcome_title: Pick a feature on the left
ozn.windows_text: The frame fits a program window exactly
